description: Default capabilities for Lost Harness M1 — allows the Svelte frontend to call our app-defined commands and use core event/window plugins.
comment: Plugin commands ARE ACL-gated (this app's ~90 hand-rolled commands are not), so a
plugin command the frontend calls must be listed here.
`process:allow-restart` backs the one plugin command the webview actually invokes:
the relaunch button shown after an update installs (`plugin:process|restart`).
`process:allow-exit` is deliberately NOT granted — nothing needs the webview to be
There is deliberately NO `updater:*` permission. tauri-plugin-updater's commands
(check / download / install) are driven from Rust only, so that the launch-check
toggle in Settings -> About is the single gate on update egress and can be proven
in `cargo test`. Granting `updater:default` here would open a second, ungated path
to the network from the webview. See src-tauri/src/updater/mod.rs.
